narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our exploration of trigonometric ratios! In this lesson, we're going to dive into the fundamental concepts of trigonometry, starting with how we define these important ratios. By the end, you'll have a solid understanding of what they are and how they relate to right-angled triangles. Let's begin our journey into the world of angles and sides!
